description_en: Query Intelligent Contact Bot conversation records
description_zh: 查询智能联络机器人对话记录
name: ListDialog

parameters.help_en: The unique job ID of the robot outbound call task. You can view it in the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) interface or obtain it by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html API.
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)界面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The called number. You can view the called number in the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) > Details interface or retrieve it by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718009.html API. The Called parameter in the API response is the called number.
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)>详情界面查看被叫号码或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718009.html接口获取被叫号码，接口返回的参数**Called**即为被叫号码
parameters.name: called
